summary: Sysco Corp and numerous co-registrant subsidiaries filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement on 2026-09-24 under an existing shelf registration, a routine debt or equity takedown rather than a special situation. The excerpt lists only registrant identifiers, CIK numbers, and addresses; it discloses no stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, collateral, or regulatory clock. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, or restructuring terms are stated. Watch subsequent pricing and use-of-proceeds disclosure for any leverage or capital-return implications.
